profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Graduated from Virginia Tech with B.S. in Computer Engineering and Computer Science minor.
Full stack developer.

If you'd like to chat or have any questions please contact me at fionak.se@gmail.com

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: GitHub Coordinator
positions.description: As a GitHub coordinator, I help facilitate collaboration on Virginia Tech's official repositories. I also encourage underclassmen to learn how to use Git/GitHub by assisting in workshops and creating tutorials they can follow on GitHub!

positions.title: Promotions and Web Master
positions.description:
As a officer of FASA (Filipino American Student Association) 's promotions, I was given the task of creating digital fliers that would be used to promote our events. These fliers were printed to be spread on Virginia Tech's campus and were shared on FASA's social media platforms.
As webmaster, I decided that the FASA website needed to be recreated in order to suit mobile technology. Using responsive UI design via Bootstrap, the website is now possible to view on all devices from smartphones to tablets to desktops. Once I retired from this position, I entrusted the next webmaster to main and update the site by simply replacing images and text.
